title: Video by earn.edits
description:
🚀 What if the next supercar didn’t just drive like a rocket, but actually looked like one? 🏎️

📼 This retro-style motion piece explores Tesla’s next-generation Roadster and a concept that sounds almost unreal: SpaceX-inspired rocket thrusters. The promise is extraordinary, with rocket-like acceleration and a design closer to a spacecraft than anything on the road ⚡

🛸 But there’s a difference between extreme acceleration and actual flight. Rocket thrust doesn’t automatically make a vehicle fly, and Tesla has yet to demonstrate that the Roadster can take off 👀

🎞️ Built with a retro-futuristic documentary look: cinematic visuals, dramatic compositions, rocket thruster effects, and kinetic typography carrying the story from the opening hook to the final reveal

💭 It’s the space between bold promises and real engineering, where futuristic technology meets the limits of what’s physically possible
